name: Menu Sysmon
author: rfaile313
description: System monitor bar widget for Omarchy: live CPU, RAM, disk, network throughput, fan RPM and CPU temperature, read straight from /proc and /sys with no daemon and no dependencies.

barWidget.description: CPU, RAM, disk, network and fan usage in the bar

schema.label: Fields
schema.description: Comma-separated metrics to show, in order: cpu, ram, disk, net, fan.

schema.label: Refresh interval
schema.description: Seconds between samples. CPU and network rates are averaged over this window.

schema.label: Left click
schema.description: Shell command to run on left click.

schema.label: Right click
schema.description: Shell command to run on right click.

schema.label: Warn at %
schema.description: Highlight the widget when CPU, RAM or disk passes this percentage.
